reader: AI agents working for MV2 of Munim, Inc.; not yet checked by a person
set: the 244 trials in consent-phrase-trials.csv with only the near-variant line (stock_exact False, stock_loose True) that name a representative, guardian or surrogate (adult_path True)

groups.washu: the snippets match the pattern below: the Washington University wording 'IRB approved written informed consent document (or that of legally authorized representative, if applicable)'. Classified by pattern, not read one by one
groups.nci_lar: nci_lar_may_sign is True: NCI's template sentence 'Legally authorized representatives may sign and give informed consent on behalf of study participants'. Classified by pattern, not read one by one
groups.other: every other trial of the 244; all were read by eye from their snippets and marked below

search_counts.note: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search counts (countTotal), not recomputed from the CSV

pattern_rule: a washu or nci_lar trial counts as an adult permission when the trial is adult-only (adult_only True), as in consent-read.json

rules.adult_permission: the wording lets a representative, guardian or surrogate consent for the participant, and the trial is adult-only (registry minimum age 18 or more)
rules.physical_only: a representative may sign only when the participant is physically, not mentally, unable to
rules.minor_only: the path is named only for parents, parents and guardians, or children, and the trial is not adult-only
rules.unclear: a path is allowed, the trial is not adult-only, and the wording does not say whether it is for minors or adults
rules.not_a_permission: the hit is not a way for the participant to take part: a drug name, a prohibition, an explicit exclusion, or the participant is the parent or caregiver
